notes.title: WWAATD EA v0.81 general patch
notes.content:
[p]A patch with bugfixes and optimisations![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/867ee47ab069b6a0f190cc2c7251eae6b743756d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]V0.81 out now!
[/h2][p]v0.81 is primarily a bugfix patch, but we also wanted to reintroduce the teeth in the game a bit: Blood & Sand made things a bit too easy! [/p][p]Aside from a small army of bugfixes, in this patch, the AI is generally more competent and active, stamina has been rebalanced and Controller controls have gotten some upgrades.[/p][p][/p][h1]AI behavior and combat improvements[/h1][list][*][p]AI now attacks more frequently, is generally more active.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented AI from throwing weapons or taunting [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that made AI dashes basically have no effect, reintroducing dash avoids and dash-attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Increased chance for AI to throw weapons. (AI now also has a chance to throw and pick up weapons of one tier lower)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved AI behavior to reduce erratic switching between blocking and dropping block [/p][/*][*][p]AI now has different behaviors to recover from low stamina (less stuck at 0 stamina/gassed out)[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina regen is now also based on movement, standing still recovers stamina faster than in movement[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Combat controls for gamepad:[/p][list][*][p]Camera movement locks during attacks and eases back in afterward which allows the player to be more in control when locking in an attack[/p][/*][*][p]Quick flicks with the Right-joy button (R3) in combination with the Right Trigger (R2) now correctly register the attack direction. Remember that pressing R2 first and R3 second will give you control on the Attack Direction widget[/p][/*][*][p]In Classic Mode, we fixed an issue where the player twisted away from enemies when attacking[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved spear handling a little bit (AI and player)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved lighting and reflections on some maps (Some arenas were really dark - may still get improved in some ninja-patches the coming weeks)[/p][/*][*][p]Items thrown in the arena are now limited to Sandbox item selection as intended[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]Bugfixes[/h1][h2]Critical[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a crash that occurred when rerolling many times or quickly. We've optimised the system so rerolling is now smoother/faster and more reliable than ever[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a memory leak / increasing lag related to rerolling characters (and possibly long game session)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where unlocks and permanent buffs reset after reloading the game[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug where a difficulty run was replaced by the sandbox default profile[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where abandoning a sandbox run let players access the Sandbox Editor for that profile[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where players could abandon a run and still ESC out of the paused menu with the abandon prompt open.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Unique items and Destructibles (Fancy Bottles etc) having 0 gold value[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed broken UI due to localisation on the Dialog Events[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other[/h2][list][*][p]Resolved an issue where item icons got stuck to the mouse cursor in Career Menu[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a Gamepad issue preventing navigation to some inventory slots[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Weekly Report notifications stacked and appeared multiple times[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Character Trait tooltips wouldn’t disappear. [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized tooltip placement for gamepad (Steam Deck esp.)[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug where players received the one-armed trait visual after certain rerolls[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed extreme physics behavior when standing on the edge of a rotating platform[/p][/*][*][p]Finally (hopefully) fixed the issue in Draft fights where veggies were thrown due to the Villain trait[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs on The Advantian Arena and Lion’s Roar maps where players could enter the arena early[/p][/*][*][p]Item droppers now properly track sandbox item overrides[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Character Overview screen showing a different backstory icon than the Utility Menu Backstory tab[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a UI bug where hovering over "Allow anonymous gameplay data collection" displayed the wrong tooltip[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the double dash setting did not save correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players couldn’t reopen the Trait Overview window multiple times from the Utility menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some destructible items no longer had a shop value[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Alluora's Boy character trait[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where certain events had extra line breaks and hidden buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved various impossible bets and small bugs related to the new betting system[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed/improved physics on Long Cloak and Halfcloak[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Dormorii Scale shirt, which incorrectly had Hanian properties[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the Raider Chaka, which was incorrectly listed as a polearm instead of a two-handed axe[/p][/*][*][p]Many many more, but why waste time keeping track when you can spend that time fixing bugs?[/p][p][/p][p]We who are about to die salute you,[/p][p]Lino & Jordy[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/0da879dde9d11df4ccbf87a958d47c4fd05ed92a.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Blood & Sand OUT NOW!
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/3bd04ec9270963c1f8b7875961e68b4ca2eb4bcb.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/df9ab8a06022c7ccfbbed006570b93ac9b41186e.gif"][/img][/h1][h1][b]Early Access v0.8 - Blood & Sand[/b][/h1][h1][b]Full Changelog[/b][/h1][p][b]We Who Are About to Die Early Access v.0.8 is here![/b] It's finally time to share this major update with you![/p][p]We wanted to overhaul combat, add Sandbox Mode and tackle the most common feedback by the community.  [b]There's lot to explore with the Blood & Sand update! [/b][/p][p]For more details, check out [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/973230/view/534351013109302036"]Preview #1[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/973230/view/534351647699110507"]Preview #2[/url] or [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/973230/view/534352273139042515"]Preview #3,[/url] or check out this [b]overview video[/b], which is a complete look at all the new stuff in Blood & Sand! [i](I recommend watching on Youtube!)[/i][/p][previewyoutube="Fsbs01TV56Y;full"][/previewyoutube][h1][b]MAJOR new content & features[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]NEW: [/b]Sandbox Mode[/h3][list][*][p]Sandbox mode allows you to [b]customize dozens of settings[/b] in the game, changing it fundamentally, and make a [b]Sandbox Profile [/b]to play[/p][/*][*][p]Make your own flavor of the game! Make challenge runs and experiment![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW: [/b]Sandbox Steam Workshop support[/h3][list][*][p][b]Share[/b] your Sandbox profiles with other players on the Steam Workshop[/p][/*][*][p][b]Browse[/b] and [b]download[/b] other players' runs! [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/973230/workshop/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/973230/workshop/[/url][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW: [/b]Combat - Attack Direction UI[/h3][list][*][p][b]A new UI[/b] that shows the possible attack directions[/p][/*][*][p]The new UI is context-sensitive based on the weapon type[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]OVERHAUL: [/b]Combat Animations & Physics[/h3][list][*][p][b]We rebuilt the entire character physics and animation systems.[/b] No more weak hits and hit reactions. [/p][/*][*][p]Every physics ‘state’ is reworked resulting in general physics stability (eg. at low or high FPS as well)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New: Animation based Hit reactions[/b] instead of 100% pure physics impulses. Movement and hits are more realistic and fluid[/p][/*][*][p][b]More stable and reliable tired / low stamina:[/b] new Stamina-based animation that adds a clear visual cue for a character’s stamina level. Physics will no longer completely take over the character’s body and you can see heavy breathing[/p][/*][*][p][b]New:[/b] Pelvis turning during attack, footwork & foot planting resulting in more powerful strikes ("Heavy attacks")[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Combat Stance and Idle poses[/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements, better blending and smoothing across all animations [/p][/*][*][p]Improved look-at animation (eye contact) and torso bending[/p][/*][*][p]Improved death ragdolls[/p][/*][*][p]Improved animation reaction on knockbacks (character dynamically balance with their arms)[/p][/*][*][p]Soft version of hit reactions play on shield hits too. Based on how you hit the shield, this can create openings[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved proportions of the characters[/p][/*][*][p]Big makeover for the character in the Career Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to the character general stance and pose for 2H weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Many many attack animation tweaks across all weapon types[/p][/*][*][p]Countless other physics and animation tweaks[/p][/*][/list][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/9201dc7404668d301db37f146dc46e0a362f4967.gif"][/img][/h1][h3][b]OVERHAUL: [/b]Polearms[/h3][list][*][p][b]3 new attacks for Polearms![/b] Left, Left up and Left down stabs have been added to replace the old generic knockback attack[/p][/*][*][p]Blunt polearm stabs now act as knockback attack[/p][/*][*][p]Polearm stabs update (more correct damage types, stats)[/p][/*][*][p]Moved most polearms up the hands, meaning longer reach[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tooltips to reflect stance switching and more[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW: [/b]Weekly Report panel[/h3][list][*][p]A majority of the post-battle notifications are now neatly grouped into a Weekly Report panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Shows an overview of all the match bracket levels + how the player rank affects them[/p][/*][*][p]Timeline panel now appears in the new weekly report panel[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Betting Overhaul[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New:[/b] Smart Bets. Eliminates impossible bets[/p][/*][*][p]Betting is now integrated in the match option panels[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the amount of bets to three bets per match[/p][/*][*][p]More user friendly: players will get a warning when switching matches or rerolling and there are active bets[/p][/*][*][p]Bets now also payout patron Favor[/p][/*][*][p]Increase of the minimum bet payout[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Patrons System Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]16 new[/b] patron events![/p][/*][*][p]Added Patron [b]"Festivals" - [/b]special events that also appear on the Calendar. Each run may only have 1 festival[/p][/*][*][p]Complete redesign of the Patron UI panels and tooltips providing much more information and clarity about the system[/p][/*][*][p]A general rebalance of Favor[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h1][b]MINOR (Content, features, balancing changes)[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3]Weapon Stance Switching[/h3][list][*][p]Now players can switch between 1H or 2H stances if the weapon is a weapon hybrid (ie. spear/polearm, or 1H/2H weapons) [/p][/*][/list][h3]Career[/h3][list][*][p][b]2 extra shop slots[/b], 8 total [/p][/*][*][p]Rearrangement of the shop layout: Shop reroll button notes.title: Blood & Sand Update: Preview #3! + Release Date for Blood & Sand!
notes.content: [h1]Ave Aspirants![/h1][p]It's already time for [b]Preview #3[/b] of the [b]Blood & Sand[/b] update! We're getting closer and closer to the update release - we'll reveal the release date for the Blood & Sand update at the end of this post![/p][p][/p][p]In this Preview, let's dive deeper into the [b]Physics Overhaul[/b], [b]Optimizations[/b] and more [b]Career changes[/b]![/p][h1]Combat - Physics Overhaul![/h1][p][b]Blood & Sand[/b] brings a pretty extensive Physics Overhaul. Now I want to preface this by saying, this kind of stuff will still happen:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/a0516bb27f46a6ae02a5cf7ca628d32f355e456a.gif"][/img] The game is designed like that! [i]Goofy antics intact.[/i][/p][p]As seen in Preview #1, Blood & Sand has hit-reaction animations now, where in the past this was a pure (often crazy) physics impulse. This has been made far more subtle and that's what lead me to the physics again. [/p][p]In the end, [b]I rebuilt the entire character-physics and physical animation systems in the game[/b]. I took some time to more properly understand the engine and implemented it this time "as it should be". [/p][p]This was really worth it - the result is more quality and stable physics in general. Everything feels more realistic and fluid.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/d584a383a97c7b4ecc2dcb51bb24e8f847749126.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/5cc74fbef05ae452bbed161c4e7f72d7f21ccec8.gif"][/img][/p][h2]FPS and system stability[/h2][p]One major boon from these overhauled physics is that the game is more FPS stable - actually (technically) playable at something like 5 FPS for the first time. This means in general, whether you're playing at 30 FPS or 200 FPS, the physics should behave closer to how they're designed.[/p][h2]Better death ragdolls[/h2][p]There are several ragdoll profiles now, which adds some cool deaths![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/dd356b6d8e700e78599282642da8dd9dd8d3cb1b.gif"][/img]death [/p][h2]Better Proportions (again!)[/h2][p]I feel like I do an improvement every Major Update on this, but this may actually be the last time. [/p][p]The proportions and physics are oddly linked, so it only seemed right. [i]We Who Are About To Die[/i] has evolved over the past ~10 years from a fairly cartoony game to more stylised-realistic. The biggest change was the child-like-cartoony-big-head proportions of characters, which have constantly evolved to be more realistic. [/p][p]Blood & Sand is no different! 'OLD' here is the currently live update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/a49cbbe35a0c26bbcadaa7e618357e37f376df1a.png"][/img][/p][p]This time, the [b]character in the Career Menu has also gotten the same upgrade[/b]! That one was a few updates behind, and still looked especially cartoony. [/p][p]The physics are also noticeably better here and so I made them more pronounced![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/40d3fe313bee6d4eb1ff8c5eb22fe0676d27d4c3.gif"][/img][/p][p]I've also redone and adjusted some of the animation stuff, like the general stance, and posing for 2 handers:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/bd5529b36c474c1968dd40da466a37785c501a93.png"][/img][/p][p]Just for fun, check out these old version of the proportions (which were already way less cartoony than start of development!) [/p][p]Image #2 is from the [b]actual Early Access Release!![/b] It really highlights how far we've come already to me.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/031451b32784e899d752236e34547dae3147f48f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/be3362c88caac526e4627be1a8c97e15c841012f.png"][/img][/carousel][h2]Better Physical Animations[/h2][p]The physical animations -- where it blends between an "active ragdoll" and animations during combat (after hit etc) have been improved and balanced. Generally speaking, again, movement is more realistic and fluid.[/p][p]Especially during low stamina, the physics no longer completely take over the body, instead you still maintain decent control but there are more animation driven cue's that a character is out of gas. [/p][p]To rebalance this, general damage output of a low-stamina hit is lower. (as previously, it relied on floppy arms more). Here it is again from Preview #1:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/91c94206bc189e5e3633cc3350bda1ee7b4e89bc.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Optimisations[/h1][p]The engine upgrade we did should come with general optimization improvements. On top of that, characters have seen a decent performance upgrade. [/p][p]Hand in hand with the animation upgrade, there's a pretty significant animation performance upgrade too across the board.[/p][p]We've also fixed the super-framerate-y look of distant Aspirants and Audience. Basically, the farther a character is the more animation frames we skip. But in the past, this skipping was harsh like stop motion. Now it's made fluid in 90% of cases. This has the extra effect that we can actually skip way more frames -- it looks much better AND is more performant!  It's hard to see well on a GIF, but:[/p][p]Here's the old version (stop motion harsh frames at different Level-of-Detail). The numbers are how many frames are skipped.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/220d8a2930a0f58125b4f1ee6160bf9f69c764b7.gif"][/img][/p][p] And new, with fluid blending.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/e68188f5ac5e91cee2c81705fb0d11393d386b57.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, the many dust, fog and other particle effects in the game has gotten a pass, replacing transparency with a technique called dithering where-ever possible, and redesigning and optimizing some key effects from the ground up. [/p][p]Again a benefit here is more effects are possible as they are much cheaper, so sandy-arena battles should get way more dusty for example! And this should be a nice boost to FPS and FPS stability.[/p][h1]Career Menu changes[/h1][h3]Shop Expansion![/h3][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/e6dedc8caeb3731ec7297cbd903fe2f36b0b32dc.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][b]We've expanded the shop with two additional item slots - 8 total now -[/b] This means more items to choose from! [/p][p]To make room for the extra items, we’ve rearranged the layout slightly. You’ll now find the reroll button, as well as shop-discount and -refund info, located at the bottom of the shop.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/030e31cd29ec40d46beef4b44df252ec776e7ae1.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve also upgraded the [b]resolution of shop icons[/b]. They’re now much [b]crisper and clearer[/b], making it easier on the eyes when browsing for new items.[/p][h3]Weekly Report[/h3][p]This update will introduce the [b]Weekly Report panel[/b], a major improvement to the player's post-match experience. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/f914096e5ad2fde01fd8854457df462f90ee77eb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Previously, after a match, players were sometimes bombarded with many panels - battle reward, shop orders, repairs and more. Quite overwhelming. [b]With this update, all of the notifications are now neatly grouped into a Weekly Report panel[/b]. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/231a7c80c328f79acd192b4726a64dabaed76d40.jpg"][/img][/p][p] Aside from that, the panel [b]also includes an overview of al the match bracket levels.[/b] This is an important mechanic of the game that was previously easy to overlook. [/p][p]Each match type has its own level. A player's level can be lower than a match’s bracket level, but never higher. When a player levels up, all bracket levels increase accordingly, keeping progression consistent across the board.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/f62824f714575ffa588e5aca0b1d085f31190aa3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The old Timeline panel is also incorporated in the Weekly Report.[/b] It still shows upcoming matches and will highlight key events. [/p][p]The Weekly Report panel can be easily accessed via the button at the top of the Career menu. The ideal place to plan your next move![/p][p]This report menu is a first version, we're going to expand and polish it up at a later date.[/p][p][/p][h1]WANNA PLAY NOW?[/h1][h1]CALL #2 FOR CLOSED TESTERS![/h1][p][/p][p][b]If you want to try Blood & Sand ahead of time:[/b][/p][p]We are currently in the debugging and polish stage of this update and we can use your help! notes.title: Blood & Sand Update: Preview #2!
notes.content:
[h1]Ave Aspirants![/h1]
Lino here, co-developer on We Who Are About to Die. Like Jordy, I wear a lot of hats: coding, art, design,... The main difference? Unlike Jordy, I usually do my work with pants on! 

I'll be showing some of my work in this post! For Preview #2 of the Blood & Sand update, I'm excited to share some of the latest updates to the [b]Career management[/b] and [b]combat visual effects[/b], as well as a [b]call for closed testers![/b]

[h1]Patrons Upgrade![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/51879856b2e49c175297ffc78db7762704c94501.png[/img]
From the start, we’ve always intended for Patrons to play a meaningful role during a run. I'm happy to announce that, with the new Blood & Sand update, you can now make more [b]meaningful decisions [/b]regarding which Patron to support and see a [b]clearer impact on your gameplay.[/b] 

The Patron system has seen lots of little broad adjustments. Patron Events are more likely, Favor gain pacing is higher and there are more ways to earn Favor now too. Many of the new features allow you to lean more towards someone specific - building up favor in a strategic way really pays off over the run.

[h3]Events[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/cb39fb6503e3b54082d4c91fb3a5a229cacc2516.jpg[/img]
Firstly, we've[b] added 15 new Patron events[/b], bringing more variety to each run. Each Patron now offers a[b] balanced mix of positive and negative events [/b]that will trigger based on your Favor standing with them. For example, each patron has an event that increases the likelihood of matches being hosted by them, giving you the opportunity to further specialize as their disciple. 

Other events [b]may grant free shop orders, increase bet payouts or even reward (or burden) you with a temporary Character Trait.[/b] All this and more is waiting for you to discover!

[h3]Festivals[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/f36127785b73eee11af58ad65889c6075f901c22.jpg[/img]
We are also introducing[b] Patron hosted Festivals![/b] These are [b]special positive events, that can occur once per run[/b]. There's the Festival of Wine, Festival of Blood, Festival of Masks and the Festival of Fortune!

Each Festival has special effects for the entire week it takes place. After a few weeks of preparation, the[b] city of Terantia[/b] will come alive with [b]celebration, decorations, and bonuses tied to the Patron![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/ecfb04d3d00e6fff4196b25ff537a8279e0a268d.png[/img]
I won't spoil all 4, but for the Festival of Fortune for example, Valerius will make sure that gold spills from fallen Aspirants. Even more, Valerius will distribute pouches of coin to the crowd, who will eagerly hurl them toward the Aspirants they hope will succeed! 

[h1]Betting Overhaul[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/14c67fa399721b80d0713bac43e82b4eabf56831.gif[/img]

One major goal of the Blood & Sand update is to address community feedback and to strengthen the weaker systems. Next to other systems that will talk about in upcoming previews, [b]betting has received a complete rework.[/b]
Instead of 4 betting options in total (shoved in a menu on the side), I've [b]integrated the betting panel directly into the match option panel[/b], meaning there are now [b]3 bets per match[/b], and making it much easier to see which bets are possible on which match. 

[b]We are also introducing smart bets![/b] Eliminating impossible or nonsensical choices.
[b]Next to an increase of the minimum payout, bets will now also pay out Favor[/b] with the Patron hosting the match, which circles around to the Patron Expansion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/9e95c9dcec10e44d3fe3da059b8b6d2dab99023e.jpg[/img]

I've also [b]redesigned the Patron UI panels and tooltips[/b] to show all related benefits and information at a glance. For example, some players might not have been aware that your Patron standing influences match payouts and fundraising. After a victorious fight, it is also clearer how your favor with each Patron changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/f5e6c3ec3c76a1eb43859a5fa82b882ba93e7fb5.gif[/img]


[h1]Combat - FX Upgrades and more![/h1]
With the new anim & physics updates, it was the perfect time for us to also enhance the current visual effects for combat.
Since shields play such a crucial role in combat, I've added [b]visual damage on the shield[/b] itself, which directly indicates its remaining durability. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/8144893931d06be94f50ae626656783363a5cdad.jpg[/img]
Above you see the first damage state which indicates a shield durability range of 50%-35%, the second damaged state shows a 35%-10% range and the last one 10% or lower. 
A cool side effect of this system is that it also shows on the inside of the shield, so [b]as a player you will also have a visual clue of your shield's durability[/b] and know when it's time to search for another shield to pick up!

In addition to [b]drastically optimizing existing FX[/b] like environmental dust, we’ve added a upgrade to all combat-related FX - [b]better shield splinters and metal sparks on impact[/b], along with [b]impact effects[/b] to clearly show the exact point of your strike on enemies. There is more dust scattered up due to combat, better and clearer footstep FX and SFX and more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/d8fcead7bb79018bca69afc69cf321adba44b5ad.gif[/img]

[h3]Audience Items
[/h3]
Another noticeable thing is [b]I've overhauled the way the audience throws in items.[/b] Before, the items they can throw in were taken from a limited pool of 3 items (low, mid and high tier). 
Now, it's fully dynamic - they can throw [i]any[/i] weapon or shield in the game (that is buyable) -they just throw stuff that is appropriate for the tier of the player. This effectively means more variety in combat with looted items, and buffed looting via Spoils to the Victor and Luck of the Draw.


[h1]WANNA PLAY NOW?[/h1]
[h1]CALL FOR CLOSED TESTERS![/h1]

[b]If you want to try Blood & Sand ahead of time:
[/b]We are currently in the debugging and polish stage of this update and we can use your help!
[b]We're launching a round of closed testing - do you want to help out and play this update early?[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/8PEutcdwf5]Join our Discord[/url] and write an application in the channel [i]#closed-test-application[/i]

That's it for preview #2 of the Blood & Sand update! I can’t wait for you to dive in and explore these changes. Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Blood & Sand Update: Preview #1!
notes.content:
[h1]Ave Aspirants![/h1]

Since the last update, we've been working non-stop - there's a lot to update you on, [i]so let's jump right in.[/i]

We're now [b]Aegic Entertainment[/b]! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/5575a2396d3da883412571fbd39daf3d8185efd2.png[/img]
I'm very proud to be introducing you to our studio. It has been 10 years in the making. It's been a crazy journey, from [i]solo dev in my underpants[/i] to game studio [i](in our underpants)[/i]. 
I'm glad to finally have a name now too. https://aegicentertainment.com/ (We're also hiring!)
Want to keep up to date, [url=http://discord.gg/8PEutcdwf5]join our discord here [/url]and [url=https://subscribe.jordylakiere.net/Newsletter]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] (No spam, only big announcements and giveaways etc!)

[h1]The next Major Update: Blood & Sand! [/h1]

Some amazing news I can share first is we've designed most of game all the way to 1.0 now. We're very much in the end-game now. Sandbox Mode is part of a larger plan related to 1.0 as well. We've also brought WWAATD up to the last viable engine version which should provide stability. 
The next update, [b]v0.8 is Blood & Sand[/b], introduces many [b]overhauls [/b]across both [b]combat and career[/b], and brings the long awaited [b]Sandbox Mode[/b]! We've been cooking with this one. Aside from generally polishing things, these are the goals we had for this update: 
[list]
[*] Big focus on Combat + add Sandbox mode (Blood & Sand!)
[*] Design the rest of the game till 1.0 so it all fits in a larger plan
[*] Address common feedback + tackle all weaker features/aspects (unify the game's quality)
[*] >>> For Career that is: Patrons, Betting, Notifications [i](Redesigns, reworks and overhauls)[/i]
[*] >>> For Combat: Hit impacts and reactions, physics stability, Polearm design [i](Redesigns, reworks and overhauls)[/i]
[*] >>> Fix big gaps in the equipment arsenal and content
[*] >>> Fix visually jarring elements and optimization issues (Low framerate characters, expensive FX etc)
[/list]
[h2]Sandbox Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/985a1f04f3c31c37334e3e78d56a8d41068a4a16.gif[/img]

[h3]What is Sandbox Mode?[/h3]
I've been looking forward to making Sandbox Mode for about 6-7 years. Personally super excited it's almost ready.

My vision as a game designer is that games are ultimately a toy - the magic is interaction. So I had the idea to let players [i]mess with the game on a much deeper level.[/i] Why not expose all the endless variables in the code? What if the player could adjust things the game to their liking? A bit like [b]modding, but made super convenient[/b] - so anyone can do it. AAA studios might freak out about how players could easily break the game, but well, in this case it's on you! The settings are ultra flexible including all the hazards that come with that.

Sandbox will allow people to make their own flavor of the game, make challenge runs, tweak things they don't like and generally experiment. 

[h3]How does Sandbox Mode work?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/5814559c0cb0ed6d68ac51ca12a0c5473039c65e.gif[/img]
In short, you can create [b]Sandbox Profiles[/b] with your own custom settings. 
Settings go from 50+ base variables in the game [i](Max HP, stamina, costs, match frequencies, pacing, difficulty pacing, ...)[/i] to toggling traits and items, to starting gear, toggling backstories and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/83907dcc1de9edeadbaf9436f8c0fc45c5fae262.jpg[/img]
[i]Open this image to get a sense for some of the options.
[/i]
[h3]Infinite Runs![/h3]
Want a 1HP run? More Stamina? Go for it. Dislike Peg-leg, hate 2 handers? Disable them. Want a duels only, high item cost, negative traits only, no heals run? Go nuts. 

The amount of possible runs is infinite.
[i]I've done the rudimentary math: 10^233. There are more builds than atoms in the universe. In fact, if you build a new Profile every nanosecond for every atom since the dawn of time, you wouldn't make a dent in this number.[/i]

[h3]Workshop Support![/h3]
You can then even share your Profile [b]with other players on the Steam Workshop [/b]. Or of course, browse and test other people's crazy run designs. More on that and a much more in-depth look at all the options, in a later Preview!

Sandbox mode is a scary feature to make. It was a huge and very complicated amount of work, diving deep into the game's core, and we're hoping for people to experiment and share cool challenges on the Workshop or via our Discord. Fingers crossed it was worth it! As usual, if people love it, we intend to expand it and listen to the community about how they want it expanded. Your feedback shapes this game.

[h2]Combat Changes[/h2]

The update is named [b]Blood & Sand - Sand for Sandbox, Blood for the vast combat related overhauls.[/b] Check it out:
[h3]New Combat Attack UI[/h3]

We've completely remade and drastically improved the [b]combat UI[/b]. It's also context-sensitive based on the weapon type. This UI is way more intuitive and I hope it primarily helps new players figure out the attack dragging mechanic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/0add0c506bc5d4582b78833d18e406f65f60be27.gif[/img]

[h3]Animation Overhaul[/h3]

The animation systems in the game have seen major changes:

One common feedback we got a lot was that [b]hits feel weak[/b] - sometimes it feels like [i]"punching in a dream"[/i]. I tackled this problem from both sides: [b]hits and hit reactions[/b].

[h3]Animation Overhaul - Pelvis turning, footwork & foot planting[/h3]

First, because of an ignorant technical mistake ~10 years ago when I was a clueless whippersnapper, it was very hard to add decent pelvis and foot rotation to attacks. I've tried to patch this a few times over the years, but I've finally managed to crack it by using a few clever tricks together to circumvent the problem. 

Now characters rotate on their attack-readying and then turn into a strike - including pelvis, knees and foot-work! Bonus of this approach is its completely dynamic, so it even changes per weapon type etc.

Here's 2H swings, notice the legs especially:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/3cf3a5d7ebec0a61ba13a75b6f59a7b5c02198b5.gif[/img]
Here's it is on 1H swings:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/a6afb8b3764840ba2e6505508c69c9eebcc08194.gif[/img]

You have to play to properly understand the huge impact (ha!) on the game - the game-feel and power of a hit -[i] is through the roof.[/i] 

[b]This has gameplay implication:[/b] WWAATD's damage model is physics-based, so the added rotation actually adds velocity aka damage to an attack. 
It also gets more or less intense based on weapon/attack type and current speed.[b] It's maxed out if you stand still - now you have a reason to plant your feet, because you'll do a much more powerful attack[/b]. Essentially, this feature adds emergent [i]"Heavy Attacks"[/i].

[h3]Animation Overhaul - Hit Reactions[/h3]

Hits also felt bad - in large part due to a lack of proper hit reactions. So far, they were a simple physics-impulse (did that because of solo dev - limited time). 
Now we've added actual [b]animation-based hit reactions[/b], but as usual, in a very dynamic way. 

Characters will turn and respond in several ways based on the attack impact location. They also use their arms dynamically to balance when they got knockback (in any direction). Even shield impacts get this effect, hitting a shield barely did anything in the past. This is all layered together to get satisfying reactions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/a64cdc53b54223efd56a1b372ab414b6d73864aa.gif[/img]

Here's some longer, [b]higher quality video previews[/b] on the new combat feel, OLD vs NEW:

[previewyoutube=AhvqRh7im5M;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=dF7aOQ1lX1E;full]https://youtu.be/dF7aOQ1lX1E
[/previewyoutube]

[h3]Animation Overhaul - Stamina[/h3]

Stamina was another common point of feedback. There's no clear visual cue for the character's stamina level, and on low stamina, you get very floppy and unwieldy. Decent in theory but not fun in practice. Now, low stamina is a more animation-based state relying much less on pure physics, and there's a dynamic breathing layer added to the animation on top of the sound.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/91c94206bc189e5e3633cc3350bda1ee7b4e89bc.gif[/img]

[h3]Animation Overhaul- Many more tweaks[/h3]

The entire animation system has seen [b]performance improvements, vastly better blending and smoothing[/b], I've [b]improved a huge amount of the attacks[/b], fixed look-at animation (so character keep eye contact much better - does more than you think!) and so on. 
[i]It's really just too much to tell.[/i]

And that's not all for Combat changes, there's a lot more. There's [b]new & improved FX[/b], a complete [b]Phyiscs rework[/b], a [b]Polearm Overhaul[/b], Weapon Stance Switching, and so on. I'll expand on those in the next Previews!

[h2]Patrons, Career & more![/h2]

It's not just Sandbox + Combat, we also worked on the [b]Career side[/b] - including expansions on the [b]Patrons and Shop,[/b] overhauls on things like [b]Betting, Post-Battle Notifications[/b] and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/6615cfbe8dabb8a85e28c84619ae6576469f55a7.gif[/img]

Blood & Sand, as every major update, will also have [b]new content, performance improvements and general improvements[/b] here and there across the entire game. It's a big boy. 

Join us on the next Previews when we dive into these topics!

Please let us know in the comments what you think. Which feature are you most excited for? What sandbox profile do you want to make? Are you interested in testing this update ahead of release?
Your reactions are extremely motivating - let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/9201dc7404668d301db37f146dc46e0a362f4967.gif[/img]

notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE: WWAATD EA v0.73 OUT NOW! +30% discount
notes.content:
[h1]Ave Aspirants![/h1]

For the holidays, here's our last present of the year to you - a new update: [b]new content[/b], [b]general game-improvements[/b] and [b]bug-fixes![/b]. The game is also 30% off for the Winter Sale!

Before we get into it, I want to take a moment to reflect on 2024 and thank everyone for standing by the game and by us: [b]thank you[/b]. It has been an incredible year of massive updates and I feel like the game has been absolutely transformed this year. I'm really happy with the our progress and how far it has come, and that we've still been making bold choices and overhauls in development. It's been a long year with many all-nighters! 

The [b]Animation Overhaul[/b] and the [b]Character Traits[/b] system are my personal highlights, both from a player and developer POV. [b]The Spectacles Update[/b] in particular was record breaking and it has been so satisfying & assuring to see that the work we put into this game is absolutely rewarded - the reception continues to be beyond my wildest dreams. 

I'm coming up on year 10 of development (might have already passed it, not 100% sure!) personally and still not tired of it at all. If you told me I'd go from a no-programming-skills, solo dev, no-big-hopes situation to thousands of players & a full time career with a team 10 years later, [i]I'd never believe you![/i] I'm very grateful to be given this chance.
I can't wait for 2025 and to show you what we have in store for the game! Best wishes to all of you!

[h2]New Arena![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/eb4888d4a83901ed8165c6aaa2b1d83de9895cf4.jpg[/img]
A new arena has emerged in the heart of Terantia. Located at the base of the stairs leading to the great temple, combatants are forced to face off on the city terraces. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/c6e56f4638d63a53aae2e1607330f19f1552d9b9.gif[/img]

[h2]New map variation[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/47398c4e472ac9ecec79968af89f678b984996c7.jpg[/img]
In this new variant, the Grand Plaza is scattered with oil patches and fire pots. Use the terrain to your advantage by igniting your enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/6ab07a08c699eb096ae6acbab409e113452536ac.gif[/img]
The fire system in the game has been upgraded to go with this new variation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/fa62804bc4d77f30389e41b9f7171669934d995d.gif[/img]
Throwing a fire pot ignites a fire upon impact, spreading flames to any connected oil patches nearby. When the fire pot lands, it leaves ashes on the ground, while ignited oil patches create fading ashes. These fire pots can now also be thrown into any map by the audience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/58bd689f014878f89bf2296e1eeaf3b17847f561.gif[/img]
Additionally, here's a new interactive trap that players can kick over.


[h2]Floating damage numbers and weapon trails![/h2]

We've added a weapon trail to the player swings, trails will be default on from now on:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/a28d0204add07e83b01f40b252d93cf24e1f2b8c.gif[/img]

We've also added [b]floating damage numbers[/b], this is [b]default off[/b]. You can turn it on in the Game Options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/a1529a15d91ba624cf5f8d1a91f7018a0c6e52c3.gif[/img]

[h2]Destructible Objects mini-Overhaul[/h2]
Destructible objects like barrels and boxes' mass now plays a role. Characters and players can now be pushed back by physics objects. (before, they were massless and would fly off if you ran into them with zero resistence.)
Sound effects have also been improved. On-hit sounds and floor-based sound effects have been added, so interactions like a barrel bouncing in mud now sound like a wood impact combined with mud. Particle effects have been introduced for hits and destruction, enhancing the visual feedback when props are broken.

Here's a [b]Before [/b] and [b]After[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/d78a8f7497965459befb47cdd2e12810421a8719.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/8b6fc575b0d3f6b248bf19e8ec60315058125b9b.gif[/img]

[h2]Kick Improvement[/h2]
Previously, when it comes to the destructible objects, kicking was handled purely by leg physics, but it now uses a curated forward impulse for more consistent behavior. 
Objects moving at high velocity (after a kick for example) now explode on contact and knock back and stun characters on impact.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/d06e7790a05a247fc90cf1db3ae9f79efda79ec9.gif[/img]
[h2]New Hanian Infantry Armor (Classic Roman legionary set!)![/h2]

Fitting with the last update, a classic Roman "[i]Lorica Segmentata[/i]" armor was added. About time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/007e8176eee4bb6746a0880c300ef46204d976da.png[/img] 
These armors have been added to many Hanian units as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/7f09c7dde98cc38fdd310f7037d1e4503681ee98.png[/img]

[i]Note: currently the names for these and everything else new in this update that has text will be english only. We'll update the translations later![/i]

[h2]New 2H swords[/h2]
We've added the long awaited Godly 2 Handed Sword - [b]Clavadir[/b] and a Unique 2 Handed sword for the Elite Legate Dividus !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/96282a28efe01b51da918ad6facaf7ceffe2836c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Audience item drops overhaul![/h2]

We revamped the system behind the items thrown into the arena by the audience during fights. Weapon throws will now be more varied, as the selection is drawn from [b]all[/b] weapons & shields available in the shop. The throws will also be more randomly aimed and better balanced for the player rank.

[h2]And more![/h2]

[list]
[*] Improvements to the training section. Decimal points have been removed and we added some QOL-fixes, making it easier and more straightforward to track progress when training specific skills.
[*] Characters and players now turn their head towards their target, making them look less stiff. They did this once upon a time but it was lost during the locomotion overhaul, added back in now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/3f399e3b8aeefe9fd3158c1e98be55adf8c2e4ae.gif[/img]
[/list]


[h1]Full Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New items[/b]: Hanian Infantry Armor (Chest & Arm armor)
[*] [b]New item[/b]: Clavadir (Godly 2H)
[*] [b]New item[/b]: Legate Dividus' Daaka
[*] [b]New Arena[/b]: City Terraces
[*] [b]New Arena Variation[/b]: Grand Plaza oil/fire variation
[*] [b]New [/b]weapon trails
[*] [b]New [/b]floating damage numbers (enable in game options)
[*] Added rain scenario to Grand Plaza maps
[*] Fire pot & Fire system improvements
[*] Destructibles now have mass & better physics
[*] Kicking destructibles into character stuns them now

notes.title: Gladiator's Revenge: Preview #4!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Aspirants![/h2]

Time for the final preview on Gladiator's Revenge before releasing it [b]tomorrow, November 23rd[/b], along with a Daily Deal discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/58ffc0d81a461d15c59a35c8a0b6fdebc9a24653.png[/img]

[h1]Gladiators Revenge: Preview 4[/h1]
[h2]Loading screen Tips[/h2]

The loading screen has been overhauled. You now have to press a key to continue, and a Tip will show. We have [i]many[/i] tips written out that we sorted in two categories, Combat and Career Management Tips. (and they also all come in 11 languages now!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/d0294133144bed9c8cde16519779cddee471c290.gif[/img]

The tips are more or less in order starting from simple mechanics and gameplay tips to more complex concepts. Every loading screen you automatically see the next tip, or you can cycle back and forth manually. When you enter battle, a combat tip appears and when you go back to the Career menu you get a management tip!
The tips in the battle screen have been removed and a bunch of unnecessary info in the tutorial has been cut. This is a major first step in streamlining the tutorial of the game so it's less front-heavy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/471f747b4df29a339ac53f805b4e6360f6bcbb5c.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Condemned[/h2]

Last time we introduced the second backstory, Condemned. It has seen some more updates (making it even harder!) which you'll have to find out the hard way, and we have some custom art:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/9bdba37663546fdbd2cb1682945f7ee5e1b5598c.jpg[/img]

Since the Condemned is specific and late late game content (unlocked after a Lionslayer win, only in Lionslayer) we went a little crazy with it to give a distinct flavor!

[h2]Items & various![/h2]

We've added many small tweaks, improvements, balancing changes and UI improvements. 

[b]Better Hit Reactions[/b]
A "small" but very impactful change is that we discovered damage absorbed by armor also negated the physics hit effects. This was an accidental/unforeseen result of the physics/damage system. So in the late game with extremely strong armor, units would basically stop reacting to hits, which just feels bad to play. This has been changed so now if you do 5 damage to a character but 45 damage to their armor, they will still react closer to as if they took 50 damage. It's extremely noticeable and the game feels way better throughout, but especially against high tier opponents.

[b]UI adjustments[/b]
We have some larger things like a backstory screen cleanup to small things like item tooltips now having a tier colour border!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/dfd07845e8ae66a7164411acb2bef874cb9c7226.png[/img]
Items now have a Properties section where we can list additional properties some Character traits need (bouncing board for more potential features later!)

[b]Items galore![/b]
Some more items have been finalised and we've also expanded the Veteran Aspirant subclasses to use these - same for the many new unit types.

Check out this Leather Cuirass and new Padded Armplate!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/7e4ae0e8d417a9588e7820aad436b96e352f724c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/d3b6d9eba18f8926fa3483457f7306f73199eebc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/06b49b321c83e896f36ca04a6ff02ec63c53d468.png[/img]
Would you say you're [i]hooked[/i]?

All told, [b]this update adds 50 new items[/b], all of which are more classic gladiator gear, transforming the overall feeling of the game for sure.

[h2]Update on Steam Deck support[/h2]

We've also quietly been working towards Steam Deck support. We had hoped to get full support in on this update as an extra surprise but that didn't work out.
Status now is, the game has gone from totally unplayable (maps didn't load, game freezes etc) to what should be fully playable now. 
We still have a lot of QoL and UI problems to fix, which should be next, but in theory the game is playable on SD officially and we're hoping to get this verified by Steam so we go from "Unsupported" to "Playable"! The next and last step ("Verified") is our goal ASAP after that, but there are still some tricky technical challenges involved to get to proper support, so I can't give an ETA just yet. Just wanted to give an update on the status and plan!

notes.content:

[h2]Dear Aspirants![/h2]

Time for Preview 2 and more details on the new backstory: Veteran Aspirant!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/0be38df8cf930d343f2c2693733592aa5aa9b744.png[/img]

In this backstory you are a Veteran fighter with an [b]already established career as an Aspirant[/b]. You are [b]hellbent on revenge[/b] after an Aspirant called Baegar was the only one to defeat you, knocking you off your throne and becoming Aspired before you. Your only purpose in life is to defeat Baegar the Aspired.

When you roll the backstory you also roll one of the 3 subclasses at random and the associated backstory's traits, the equipment loadout and starting skills will adjust based on the subclass. 3-in-1!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/58ffc0d81a461d15c59a35c8a0b6fdebc9a24653.png[/img]

[b]The Dormorian[/b]

The Dormorian is a trident-wielding class originating from Dormorum. To facilitate progress in this class we've added a full set of Tridents and Helms across all tiers of the game specifically tailored to the Dormorian, on some of some unique chest armor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/a1d3b394367fb3166434fb514ee0e54774111b89.png[/img]
[i]Notice the new Character Trait Dormorii Training, which we also have for the other cultures -- more on that later! [/i]

[b]The Myrodonian[/b]

The Myrodonian is an overhaul/expansion of an already existing unit in the late game. This is a Myrodon-inspired class of Aspirant, known for their majestic Myrodonian Helm, trusty flail and armguard. Again, we've added Flails to the game across all tiers so you can enjoy your unique Flail damage bonus as the Myrodonian the entire playthrough, if that's what you want.

[b]The Terantian[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/5db04ddb22fa7f0f5978c2b98a6f938ed1893649.png[/img]

A local Aspirant class, the Terantian is a more standard roman-inspired class with equipment more reminiscent of the military - save for the "Claw" or glove type weapon he wields, of course. And you guessed it, we've added claws to the game across all tiers!

As mentioned in Preview 1, the general direction of this update was also to add more classic gladiator gear, so we've added a lot of items in this direction. notes.title: Champion's Journey: Preview #4! 1 day to release!
notes.content:
[h2]Ave Aspirants![/h2]

With this last and final preview on the Champion's Journey Update, we want to reveal the new [b]Character Overview[/b], [b]Weight[/b] and [b]skill systems[/b], a new map and [b]reveal more character traits[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/3ef9641e139a3518c258c17a0dda0dc1129cd4cc.png[/img]

[h1]The Character Overview Panel[/h1]

The Character Overview panel provides all the essential information about your character at a glance. You can access it in the Armory, the old shop panel can now tab between this and the shop itself.
On this panel you can review your character's skills, along with active item modifiers, as well as see the active Character and Run Traits.

In addition, the panel displays your current Health, Stamina, Stamina Regeneration, and Fame Multiplier. It also shows your Total Weight and provides a convenient overview of your Armor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/b4a9b38179e91155f5321f62f55db8be84695112.jpg[/img]

[h1]Weight System[/h1]

[b]Player weight[/b] has been overhauled. All items have a newly balanced weight stat (previously Stamina Regeneration), and your total weight drops you into a category: [b]Light, Medium, or Heavy.[/b]

Light and Heavy come with specific advantages and disadvantages. When you are Light you gain movement buffs, while Heavy gives you debuffs. Heavy does give you stun bonuses, and of course, you will be wearing much more armor and better weapon/shield.
These act as a threshold but within each class you get more and more of this buff/debuff, so going VERY light is still better than just barely light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/559708d151a85a5218f8369bb8497ee6d8598787.gif[/img]

These weight classes give you a new choice to make: fight as a nimble and agile Aspirant, or go tank mode? You've now got a reason to take off certain pieces of armor, or take that smaller shield, even when in the late game.

We've also introduced character traits that are influenced by your total weight or influence your weight, [i]it's all connected[/i].

[h1]Bonus Skill[/h1]

Hand in hand with weight, traits, item traits and more is the new [b]Bonus Skill system[/b]. Your character overview panel shows your buffs at a glance, including a breakdown where they come from.

In this example, I'm a Light weight class, and I'm wearing 2 sandals which give me Swift x2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/dd9f104abb6f134360a22731ac4e4ff5f028a06d.png[/img]

Some bonus skill can be negative too, and skills can now also go to 125 (but only via Bonus Skill) 

With all these new mechanics, building a character has more depth than ever.

[h2]A new arena: City Market![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/c46d91f7ae45563aa31802c0443ff42dfc40370e.gif[/img]

Welcome to the grand opening of a new arena in the heart of the Inner City! Located just next to the Grand Plaza, the City Market Arena offers a gathering spot for Terantians to witness thrilling battles and engage in lively market exchanges. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/4a6586873a10583af61202b4dd73d04ee709db20.png[/img]

[h1]Preview #4 Trait Reveals![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/38ce099d3181dce849ce387e374d2eb4239d546d.jpg[/img]

Let's have a look at another Major Positive, Neutral and Negative Character Trait!

[h2]Brute Strength[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/dd31e43808b715c5c493931b68312af7e5b005cf.jpg[/img]

It takes brutish strength to destroy's enemy's weapons and armor! You get [b]+50% Durability damage [/b]when you are in the [b]Light [/b]or [b]Medium [/b]weight category, and a very tangible [b]+100% Durability damage[/b] when in the [b]Heavy[/b] weight category.

A good synergy is using an axe with bonus damage vs shields along with Brute Strength, and just smash right through shields instead of around them.

[h2]Villain[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/263d7136400bdc1cf6f8f836583c9b3886fbb655.jpg[/img]

You thrive on the disdain of the crowd! Gain a [b]damage multiplier[/b] equal to your negative Fame Multiplier (up to +50% damage). Remember that some armor and items influence your Fame Multiplier in a negative way, and so does hitting team mates... Get ready to embrace your inner demon and aim for the highest negative Fame Multiplier possible!

[h2]Peg Leg[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/b3470051b39587cf2113e03fc2919c74c6bf1431.jpg[/img]

You are missing a right leg. Your right leg is permanently replaced by a Peg Leg (item)
-20 Bonus Movement Skill and you cannot dash!
Maybe later on we could add different types of peg legs you can swap out, what do you think?

We haven't revealed a ton of traits, in the mean time there's already well [b]over 50[/b]. Ultimately it's up to you to discover them in-game.
The Traits get discovered as you play with them in a trait overview panel, and we've also added a little trophy icon that shows up when you [b]win [/b]with that trait active: for the completionist, you have your work cut out!

In general, traits have been an amazing way to tie all the game's systems together or let them come forward in a more understandable way.

[h2]Release?!?![/h2]

That's it for the previews of the Champion's Journey! Let us know what you think!

I'm happy to say, the Champion's Journey update is dropping [b]tomorrow, September 16th 2024[/b] 
along with a new [b]Overview Video[/b], if all goes well!! 
We've been excited to get the character traits out there for a long time now - [i]HYPE[/i]

notes.title: Champion's Journey: Preview #2!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Aspirants![/h2]

With this second preview on the Champion's Journey Update, it's time to talk about how traits are generated and embedded in the game. We'll also reveal [b]3 new traits[/b] and a [b]brand new feature[/b] of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/3ef9641e139a3518c258c17a0dda0dc1129cd4cc.png[/img]

[h1]Trait Generation[/h1]
The highlight of the Champion's Journey update is the introduction of [b]random character traits[/b], which brings a whole new depth to the game - check out Preview #1 for the introduction. Here's how they are added to the game:

[h2]Backstory Traits[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/f388173db431e8baa7d52dadac6cab35deea1243.jpg[/img]

At the start of each new run, Aspirants will be assigned a random set of traits known as [b]Character Backstory Traits[/b]. Traits can be [b]Minor and Major, and Positive, Neutral or Negative.[/b]

A character gains a set of traits which more or less balance each other out. So you could get 1 major positive trait, 1 neutral, and 2 minor negative traits, for example.

These traits not only diversify each playthrough's strategy (or at least add a serious curveball) but also just significantly enhance the game's variety by offering different experiences every time. In short, now there are not just 7 backstories but 7 backstories each with millions of variants.

[h2]Run Traits[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/f75783d3c7a5c6cfe083d3c258a0b0249d8cfbc1.png[/img]

Some of the new [b]Rare Fights[/b] introduced in [i]The Spectacles Update[/i] (Elite Fights, Tournaments) now reward you the choice between 3 random minor positive traits, so your character can also develop during your run.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/fa2a15d0b86ad02330cca997e7a9ea68238fa8d5.png[/img]

You are allowed to skip this reward holding out for a better trait later on, up to a total of 4 run traits for any character.

[h1]Preview #2 Trait Reveals![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/a2866c82d3ccff9272857ef0a857fbaa7e238059.jpg[/img]

We're excited to introduce 3 new major traits: one positive, one neutral, and one negative.

[h2]Giant[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/86b701a7fa8086649682af896b9e9f69f8430689.png[/img]

You must have had plenty of milk growing up! As a Giant, not only are you physically larger, but you also deal +10% more damage. Throughout your run, your equipment's total weight is categorized into light, medium, or heavy. Thanks to your size, you can carry more gear, giving you a +10 to the heavy weight category threshold.
[h2]Brawler[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/fab3fb9f9ea4aa76e70190de4c2d917527640e69.jpg[/img]

If you love smashing things in the arena or just enjoy causing chaos, the Brawler trait is perfect for you. With this major neutral trait, you'll deal +5 more damage when using destructible items and another +10% when your weapon’s durability drops below 50. When the Terantian spectators sense the brawler in you, they’ll toss more destructibles into the arena, giving you even more opportunities to smash, bash, and dominate the fight with!
Your weapons will however take 25% more durability damage and break sooner. 

[h2]Unlucky[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/8741d83f5feb625a4b25ef19c7684184fa3015b4.png[/img]

For you... well, not everything goes your way. With this major negative trait, you’ll have a -20% chance of favorable outcomes in most randomized effects: events, discounts, match information, item drops, bribery attempts, and even disarming. As if surviving the arena wasn't tough enough!
Oh, and it always seems to rain around you.

[h1]Ambush![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/bee5df16858db22d260925f4b4f66d80a6cdfd93.gif[/img]

Not everyone is as trustworthy as you, and some Terantians are eager to take advantage of your success. As you navigate the treacherous streets after battle, beware of bandits lurking in the shadows, waiting for the perfect moment to strike! Danger could be hiding around every corner...

An Ambush is a random event which will take you to new parts of the city of Terantia to fight off any looters that dare to fight you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/dfe70e2558ba7723c9599d7db7d0e78cf254062c.png[/img]

We are currently in the debugging and polish stage of this update. To help us out we're running closed tests - do you want to help out and play this update early?

notes.title: Champion's Journey: Preview #1!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Aspirants![/h2]

With the recent Spectacles Update having been a massive success, we are excited to already start showing off the next version of We Who Are About To Die! Introducing the next major update: [b]Champion's Journey[/b]!

This update contains a few [u]major[/u] character-oriented features that change the game completely, yet again. We are adding a good deal of QoL, bugfixes and - of course - content, but the most prominent features are oriented around the player character, the mainliner being [b]Character Traits![/b]

[h1]Character Traits[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/3ef9641e139a3518c258c17a0dda0dc1129cd4cc.png[/img]
Traits are randomly added to your character, and impact your character in all kinds of creative and interesting ways. 
Character Traits are [b]positive[/b], [b]neutral [/b]or [b]negative[/b], and there are [b]minor [/b]and [b]major [/b]types indicating the impact on your run. It could be something as simple as a stat increase, to as run-altering as [i]missing an arm[/i].

Backstories already have inherent traits that are always the same, so with these new random character traits on top, the game is about a million times more replayable. 

Take a look at current roster of traits above (most likely still to be expanded). I've even numbered them to fuel some speculation on what these trait icons might represent! We will reveal traits post by post.

[h1]Preview #1 Trait Reveals![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/f68e3f8b734d0457473a3b245df572295b27d74b.png[/img]

In today's preview, we'll reveal these 3 traits! All three are [b]major[/b] traits, one positive, one neutral and one negative.

[h2]Born Leader[/h2]

Your taunt/cheer now becomes a buff that temporarily increases effectiveness and aggression of all your allies in combat. Born Leader is a trait that will guide your run to large group battles with allies.

[h2]Owakhan Heritage[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/bb1d3954774145fa20ceb2bf20f6a4ebac3b90b3.png[/img]
A neutral trait: an Owakhan Mask Spirit follows you. You gain a unique Owakhan Mask that you cannot unequip - it haunts you!

[h2]One-Handed[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/23f02c79afed1ce59d9ce0c877a57c1442630c59.png[/img]

How it happened, we'll leave up to you - but you are missing a left arm. You cannot equip left-arm armor, 2-handed weapons or a shield, but are more effective with 1H weapons. Good luck!
You can imagine the deep impact this has on a run, we also imagine character traits will be deeply connected to challenge runs the community invents (especially once Sandbox is added). 

[h1]A new arena![/h1]

In the gang-owned back-alleys near the Inner City you may find a seedy fight or two from time to time. Even if they may be hosted by those dwelling in the underbelly of Terantia - coin is coin...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/5438f74563f358c16d3dbe7113f8cb5e3211a28e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/76140ac76b3fc85d4badf39e86b081bdd2c4c62f.gif[/img]

[h1]Did you spot it?![/h1]

Over the last few months I've actually been teasing traits here and there in creative subtle ways. What was not so subtle however, was the shop in Inner City that has traits on the wall as a little easter egg! Did anyone notice?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/8961b537f195bf0b30c35c0bea022923deed1bef.png[/img]

[h1]We're at Gamescom![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/d0b213dde9645341c45e70f68a1e64717e62d9b5.jpg[/img][i]Pictured:Developer Lino thinking about Rome in Köln. (Linolians - get it?)[/i]

The entire team is at Gamescom 2024! If you're in the industry and want to chat, search for a We Who Are About To Die shirt!

notes.title: WWAATD EA v0.45 Draft update! Balancing, bugfixing... (full Changelog)
notes.content:
[h1]The Spectacles Update v0.45 changelog[/h1]

Ave Aspirants! Here's a quick [b]new update[/b]! 
We put a lot of effort into upgrading [b]Draft[/b], since everyone seemed to really like the idea. We'll do more with it in future but you can now enjoy quite a list of improvements and expansions already. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/067c0871a5c3fd32224ef10f7a0033659dacc044.png[/img]

In this update we are introducing a brand new culture, the [b]Dormorii[/b]. This is a culture of warriors based in Dormorum, which is known for being a fishing industry hub. Between land disputes and control over the river Terant, the Dormorii are a long-time enemy of the Empire of Hania and routinely raids their border around the city Terantia. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/83d264430796e13a9e2f486182bde654bada0a1c.png[/img]

For now these have gotten some basic equipment, enough to create a new faction for Draft! We will expand the Dormorii later. Can you spot the inspirations of real life cultures we mixed together? Drop a comment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/8b0955b14679331a1254d2ce97771685497db704.png[/img]

The second major goal in this update was combat balancing, especially the new dominant strategy of just holding sprint and backtracking, to avoid almost all possible damage. 
The new dynamic combat is working out great, but obviously too strong: anything overshadowing other playstyles is not great - it makes even dashing pointless for example. So we did a list of changes to both AI and player to bring some lethality back into the game.
We also did quite a bit of general balancing after all the great feedback on The Spectacles Update, and of course, as usual, many bugfixes.


[h2]Draft [/h2]
[list]
[*] Draft now has reinforcement based spawning
[*] New Draft Faction: the Dormorii
[*] New Draft unit: Captain
[*] Main Draft units split into 2h and 1h/Shield

[*] Visual overhaul of Draft field battle map (the city background, grass and foliage overhaul, lighting and scene improvements)
[*] New Draft variation: Sunset
[*] New Draft variation: Rain
[*] New Draft fortification/ballista variation
[*] The battle area in draft is wider, reinforcements spawn closer
[*] Draft now has a better intro sequence with a camera fly-over
[*] New waves on Draft are indicated with a text prompt

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/23ee2212d06b0f35e513609eb6497c6f94cc9514.png[/img]

[*] Audio improvements on Draft
[*] Draft no longer rewards fame for combat performance
[*] Draft equipment per faction has been balanced more, some adjustments
[*] Drastically reduced memory footprint of Draft map
[*] Made the map border indicators a bit less... ugly
[/list]
[h3]Ballistae[/h3]
[list]
[*] General improvements to ballista efficacy (likely still to improve later)
[*] The ballistae now also auto rotate down and upwards
[*] The range of the ballistae on Draft is increased
[*] The range indicator decals for the ballistae are removed on Draft
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/d21e2824ab4bfe0ad21dca64a56eb70b4816e83f.png[/img]

[h2]Balancing / Other[/h2]
[h3]Combat balance - Player
[/h3][list]
[*] Your character now immediately and continuously rotates to the camera aim when attacking, improving aim (esp on Spear, but everything)
[*] Fixed bug where when targeting the forward attack aim was way off to the left (oops)
[*] Reduced up and down aiming min and max (esp on Classic)
[*] Reduced the minimum speed debuff going backwards (so moving backwards you are now faster, both sprint and walk)
[*] Increased the range of the "backwards" debuff, so now when moving sideways you are slowed down quicker
[*] Slightly increased stamina cost for sprinting
[*] Stamina Regen minimum (at 0 skill) is increased slightly (meaning more Stam regen the start of a run)
[*] Attack stamina cost is now scaled more with attack speed - attacks cost less than before when at low stamina
[*] Slowed down skill experience gains to compensate for longer fights and to make training gear more useful
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/3805f9fac1301c083aa7116ce4742e1e6b9f01f6.png[/img]

[h3]Combat balance - AI
[/h3][list]
[*] AI will now sprint more (using the new mechanic as player, also a bit more dynamic)
[*] AI will now sometimes continue their movement towards their target during an attack reducing attacks that got nowhere near you (harder to just backtrack and be safe)
[*] AI will now aim predict further on left moving targets to compensate for their weapon being in their right hand
[*] AI will back off less often when in attack range
[*] AI will now have a cooldown for picking up shields so they don't run off immediately and there are more openings for the player
[*] Reduced friendly fire damage
[*] Prophet fight now has 2 additional minions
[*] Owakhan Twins now wield slightly better weapons but have slightly lower skill (to give a better reward for a difficult fight)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added new item: the Dormorii Daka (A falx like 1h sword)
[*] Added new item: Dormorii shield
[*] Added new item: Dormorii Kalas Helm
[*] Various small tweaks to existing equipment (Myrodon Mace, Bong mace is now a Dormorii mace, ...)


[*] Destroyed weapons are now removed during the fight, optimising the game
[*] Early- and mid-game maps have a chance to re-appear on bracket levels 20 and more
[*] Removed the 50% cut on the bet rewards for the Slave backstory
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where on 2h weapons, the physics state did not reset properly (causing undesirable very floppy attacks sometimes)
[*] Fixed issue where shield could disappear after a Uniformed matches
[*] Fixed a bug where Wildcard was not properly increasing in level
[*] Fixed a bug where the AI sometimes walked to their target instead of running
[*] (most likely) Fixed bug where your armor could still take damage during Uniformed (Draft) and Insurance matches 
[*] Removed some of the NPC movement/rotation jitter
[*] Polearm bash no longer drains a lot of stamina
[*] Multihits no longer cost much more stamina as regular hits
[*] Fixed issue with the ballistae where the loaded weapon would not allign correctly
[*] Fixed issue where the ballistae would continue to shoot after the fight 
[*] Fixed issue where player could not navigate to certain scolo upgrades with gamepad
[*] Fixed issue where enemies in the Great Pit could not get passed certain points in the map
[*] Fixed issue where event Unforeseen Damage damaged weapon when coming back from a battle with battle uniformed trait
[*] Visual fixes on the Great Pit
[*] Fixed issue where return button could be pressed multiple times after battle
[*] Fixed issue where the bet win with x% amount of favour would not pay out
[*] Fixed issue where the bet 'surviving allies' was not registering on tournaments
[*] Fixed issue with battle trait impatient crowd where it would use a different time than communicated on the battle panel
[*] Fixed issue where audience favour was locked after round 1 tournament
[*] Fixed bug where the player feet would sometimes continuously rotate in place when targeting
[/list]


As usual, probably missed stuff, so go find out in-game! :) 

Think we're doing a good job? Here's how to help us out (by subscribing, engaging, joining) and keep up to date:

Jordy

Over 6 months in the making, the Spectacles Update is finally here! This is our largest update [b]by a lot![/b] So much so, that we had to leave out quite a few things from this changelog and update overview video to keep it manageable!

Check out this [b]overview video[/b] and jump into the game and enjoy the Spectacles.

[previewyoutube=MzHAZ6IDNKE;full]https://youtu.be/MzHAZ6IDNKE
[/previewyoutube]


[h1]Early Access v0.4 - The Spectacles Update[/h1]
[h1]Full Changelog[/h1]

[i]IMPORTANT: Note that the Spectacles Update will reset your current active character save. [/i]

[h2]MAJOR new content & features[/h2]
[h3]New "Rare Fights" & Gamemodes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New game mode[/b] Elite Fights (Boss fights with wave based minions)
[*] [b]New game mode[/b] Draft (Army field battle)
[*] [b]New game mode[/b] Tournament (Round based combat, 2 teams)
[*] [b]New game mode[/b] Grand Tournament (Round based combat, 3+ teams)

[*] [b]New game mode[/b] Survival (Wave based combat)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/a2eaebac8b644c7791362535dcd7d788884faae8.gif[/img]

[h3]Total Animation Overhaul[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completely rebuilt all locomotion animations
[*] Reworked Sprint: you can now sprint omnidirectionally
[*] You can now perform all actions while sprinting / strafing
[*] Added additive upper body animations
[*] Reworked weapon stances
[*] Added animation details such as falling states
[*] Fixed character proportions (upper body especially) - characters look normal now!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/47cd5be36e6936ef9097517e3cfb8bb45e9e1754.gif[/img]

[h3]Total AI overhaul[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new movement system (avoids bumping etc!)
[*] Improved AI flanking and surrounding logic
[*] Added changing turn rate based on weight and actions (this allows you to flank AI!)
[*] Added skill-based telegraphing of attacks
[*] Rebalanced AI skills and attack pacing
[*] Added AI shield aiming
[/list]
[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Map:[/b]The Grand Plaza
[*] [b]New[/b] map variations (many!)
[*] [b]New Content[/b]: 21 new items 
[/list]
[h3]Total Audio overhaul[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completely reworked all combat audio assets
[*] Added three new voice sets
[*] Footstep sound and particle effects have been added for walking and running
[*] Improvements on the Impact sounds logic: sounds are now based on the item types and their materials
[*] Added variations on shield damage. Sound now scales based on amount of damage
[*] Added weight based heavy armor sound
[*] Added logic for falling objects hitting the ground
[*] Added new music tracks and SFX and intro music for special fights
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/09381bd26f2c1b243854925e69eacca149bc1c40.gif[/img]

[h1]MINOR (Content, features, balancing changes)
[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New[/b] Character Overview Panel

[*] [b]New[/b] Battle Trait: Rabble
[*] [b]New[/b] Battle Trait: Uniformed
[*] [b]New[/b] Battle Trait: Impatient Crowd

[*] Health no longer saves live during combat (so crashes are more forgiving)
[*] Added a smart Enemy team colour selection so opposite colours are used during a fight
[*] Buffed stamina regeneration on Player
[*] The max Stamina penalty from low HP now slowly regenerates over time 
[*] Stuns now actually stun the player: can’t attack defend nor shield bash/kick during a stun
[*] The game now has a smart Battle Trait Curator that better selects battle traits
[*] Added two new character skins

[*] Slight changes to the camera position and FOV for Third Person Camera mode
[*] Lowered amount of weapon drops on city center map
[*] Added a warning message on the claim victory button
[*] Clamped Patron Bribes slider to 10k
[*] Added various new unit types (Elite Minions etc.)
[*] Added durability UX/UI scaling. A scale from yellow to dark red
[*] Fame rebalance and fame is now indicated by % in victory screen
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/b4515faca054988537a63fc2eea814b75d45cbff.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Added new Weapon icons per weapon type
[*] Added new Unit Icons for elite fights
[*] Added the Ballista trap to different level variations
[*] Added the Gong trap to different level variations
[*] Added Moving Structures to different level variations
[*] Added 'slow zones' level variation to different level variations 
[*] Added thunder to The Great Pit, The Pit and the Grand Villa
[*] Updated the Grand Villa garden
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36402388/9021c19b2e617df5e81d5aa0aec15760a21ee27d.gif[/img]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Potential fixes on several different crashes
[*] Fixed bug where AI had full durability on their shields instead of damaged shields (oops!)
[*] Fixed bug where two ranks where highlighted at the same time
[*] Victory screen now shows correct battle type and bracket level 
[*] Fixed exploit where a player could go back and forth between the career and main menu to get backstory effects and payouts
[*] Fixed bug where Former Soldier health bonus was not applied correctly 
[*] Fixed bug where equipping a Farerdaka in the armory would destroy an equipped shield
[*] Fixed bug where an locked inventory slots would get a repair icon on Blacksmith backstory reroll

[*] Fixed bug where kill 3,4 or 5 enemies-bets would not pay out 
[*] Fixed bug where some godly items would not show up in the shop
[*] Match timer now starts when entering the arena after the countdown and stops on killing the last enemy standing
[*] Corrected collision boxes on Lion’s Roar Arena so player cannot get stuck anymore
[/list]

And definitely more stuff, but you'll have to find out inside the game!

If you like what we're doing, please consider sharing this update and the game with your friends: we still rely on word of mouth more than anything.
